tr.td: Say hi to the employee and ask for your reservation tonight.
Tell the guest that you can't find his/her reservation.
Tell the employee that the reservation is in your name.
Tell him/her that you found the reservation and that it's for a double room.
Tell the employee that the hotel is very clean and orderly.
Say that you agree with the guest, welcome him/her and give him/her the keys.
Say the employee that you need something else: you need a taxi.
Say the guest that the bellhop can find a taxi.
